panels.prompt: Action shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back hurls small clay bomb; blinding white flash bursts at face of hulking bald convict giant wrapped in iron chains, waist-deep in black brine, reeling.

Close shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back right against hulking bald convict giant wrapped in iron chains, waist-deep in black brine, raising hand in hypnotic sign, pale ripple toward giant's eyes.
Vision: rows of convicts on one chain hacking salt walls by lamplight; tall faceless overseer silhouette looms above, hand raised counting. Faded sepia and dusty blue, dry-brush, torn rough edges.

texts.text: Аксий не взял. Только смена — и счёт.

panels.prompt: Impact shot: huge fist of hulking bald convict giant wrapped in iron chains, waist-deep in black brine, slamming point-blank into young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back; golden translucent shell explodes into shards.

Action: japanese teen boy, black hair, blue eyes, noble cloak, glowing golden sword and tall nordic woman, blonde braids, fur and chainmail, two-handed axe hit chained giant's side, blood spraying; black-braided archer with glowing white bow points at iron ring on salt pillar.

texts.text: Цепь! К кольцу на столбе — у него за спиной!
